Imported durations floor after about 1 microsecond (706 ticks) of ffprobe's six-decimal print tolerance; for 30 fps this keeps a frame a source printed a hair under a boundary (e.g. 2.999999 s gives 90, not 89)
The probe's own durationFrames and the export check stay in thirtieths of a second (tolerance 2); project frames come from exact ticks
core/render.ts is donor-derived; its frame-margin change is recorded in imports.json
The frame rate is fixed at creation; a save that changes it is refused
